milestones.title: BC-FIPS version in use matched to a certificate, or the owner's decision recorded

remediation: Keycloak's FIPS guide asks for bc-fips 2.1.3, which Bouncy Castle describes as going into submission; the active certificates name 2.0.0 and 2.1.x. Record a certificate that names the version in use, or record the owner's decision on which certificate-listed version to run in strict mode and how it is proven to work.
title: No FIPS 140-3 certificate names the BC-FIPS version Keycloak 26.8 asks for
